concept: a candle-wax abbot who melts a little every time he lies, and lies constantly
a tide-pool anemone the size of a cart that pretends to be a rock garden
a glacier's dreaming mind, slow and enormous, that remembers every climber it has killed
a kennel-master's ghost and the three hounds that died with him, still hunting as one
a millstone golem that grinds whatever it catches between its wheels
a magpie-thing that steals voices and mimics them to lure travelers off the road
a plague-doctor construct of lacquered leather whose beak dispenses the sickness it was built to cure
a drowned cathedral's choir, one body of many mouths, whose hymn stops hearts
a hedge knight sworn to a dead king, whose oath keeps him standing after his body should have quit
